info.name: Gateway (Team 14) - Guild and Package Registry
info.description:
The API gateway, and Guild Service and Package Registry Service reached through it.

Owner: IsStephy. Gateway port: 8080.

Needs the shared stack with the gateway, User Management, Guild and Package Registry running, and the same GATEWAY_KEY on the gateway and both services. Players register and log in through the gateway (User Management issues real RS256 tokens); the gateway verifies each token, strips Authorization and forwards the verified user as X-User-Id.

Re-runnable: usernames carry {{$timestamp}}.

Package Registry's admin-only success paths are not here: admins are seeded by user id (PACKAGE_REGISTRY_INITIAL_ADMIN_USER_ID), and User Management issues fresh UUIDs per run. They are covered by collections/package-registry-service.postman_collection.json against the service on its own.
